scripts.postbuild: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/404.html'); fs.mkdirSync('dist-gh', { recursive: true }); const files = fs.readdirSync('dist/assets'); const js = files.find(f => f.endsWith('.js')); const css = files.find(f => f.endsWith('.css')); if (js) fs.copyFileSync('dist/assets/' + js, 'dist-gh/app.js'); if (css) fs.copyFileSync('dist/assets/' + css, 'dist-gh/app.css'); fs.copyFileSync('public/privacy.html', 'privacy.html'); fs.copyFileSync('public/terms.html', 'terms.html'); })"
